who: Patent law firms and solo patent practitioners who want to be found in their city.
cadence: the USPTO roster is read fresh at every site build; a Featured listing itself runs 12 months

short: The last five Customs Broker License Exam sittings, explained
who: Candidates studying for the CBP Customs Broker License Exam who want the recent papers with the official answer and a plain explanation on each question.
cadence: One payment, not a subscription. You get the whole explained bank as a single page. We add each new sitting after the April and October exams; buying again is your choice, nothing recurring.

short: Hazmat road pack, one UN number
who: Small shippers and e-commerce sellers who must ship one dangerous good by road in the US and need the federal table row, the exceptions explained and label artwork proofs.
cadence: One payment, not a subscription. You get one private web page for the UN number you name. The federal table is amended through the year; buying again is your choice, nothing recurring.

who: A founder or small business paying people on 1099 who wants one organised file ready for a state audit, a 1099 mismatch letter or a lawyer's questionnaire.
cadence: One payment, not a subscription. You get one private page you can print or save. We re-read the cited statute pages and re-check every quote; buying again is your choice, nothing recurring.

who: Small US food makers putting a first product on a shelf, who need a Nutrition Facts panel and the reasoning behind every number on it.
cadence: One payment for one product, not a subscription. We re-read 21 CFR 101.9, 101.12 and 101.4 from the eCFR every month and rebuild the food table when USDA publishes a new release, so the free pages stay current; buying again for a second product is your choice, nothing recurring.

who: A company running an AI chatbot, AI-generated content or an AI decision step that people in the EU or a US disclosure state can reach.
cadence: One payment, not a subscription. You get the notice pack as a single private page, dated. We re-read the sources about every three months; buying again is your choice, nothing recurring.

who: A notary public or loan-signing agent who wants their own state's words about a journal and a journal that keeps entries on their own device.
cadence: One payment, not a subscription. You get one private page carrying the same journal with no entry limit. The free state pages are re-read every week; buying again is never needed and nothing recurs.

who: Anyone deciding whether we hold the record they need, before they ask about price
